[BBC Business] Jensen Huang says he would be 'honoured' to return as Nvidia CEO if board asked him
Huang says he has had an "outpouring" of calls from investors and others calling for him to return.

[BBC Business] We can't afford to hire under-25s, say firms. Will Milburn plans help?
The proposal to cut employers' National Insurance costs is "essential" to tackling the Neet problem, one business group says.

[BBC Business] Where are the most jobs for 18-24 year-olds?
How many jobs are there where you live and in which sectors are you most likely to find an opening?

[BBC Business] Speed camera fault may have allowed drivers to escape fines
The Home Office has revoked approval that allowed footage from speed cameras to be used in evidence.

[CNBC] Widespread outages hit banks, air travel, the NSA and Apple, disrupting seemingly everything
Major outages showcase the risks of interconnected tech in the age of AI.

[CNBC] Homebuilder sentiment plunges to 14-year low, leading more builders to drop prices
Homebuilder sentiment fell to a 14-year low amid high mortgage rates and higher prices for energy, labor and materials. That caused more builder price cuts.

[CNBC] Wall Street's fear gauge is surging again and this time it's not just about AI jitters
VIX up four days in a row as options traders show fear unseen since April

[CNBC] U.S. officially loses measles elimination status amid ongoing outbreaks
The director of PAHO made the final call that measles is endemic — or always present — in the U.S. following 12 months of continuous transmission.

[MarketWatch] Why Salesforce’s stock led the S&P 500’s decliners amid tech jitters
A series of technology outages has investors concerned that software companies could prove “particularly vulnerable” to AI misuse, an analyst says.

[MarketWatch] ‘Can I pick your brain?’ and other terrible things to say in a networking email
Hiring for white-collar jobs usually dips in November and December, so try sending “cold emails” to your network instead.

[MarketWatch] ‘It leaves me with a sour taste’: My elderly mother gave our cousin $800 for a car repair. Should I be worried?
“I know older people can easily feel patronized, and I don’t want that to happen.”

[MarketWatch] Summit Therapeutics’ stock tumbles again as FDA recommends new trial for lung-cancer drug
The U.S. regulator’s disclosure was more extensive than what the biotech company had announced Sunday.
